$comment: PE-ownership policy (§29) for the SignPath-signed 1.1.x line. Every PE in the release tree must classify as owned or upstream; unknown PE = build stop (verify-signing-scope.js --mode signpath). owned = valid SignPath signature required; upstream = must NOT carry the project SignPath signature.

ownedSigned.note: §27: the ONLY project-owned signature target for 1.1.0. Installer/uninstaller EXEs may only be added after their complete source and build process live in the repository.

rules.unknownPe: fail-closed: any PE not matched by ownedSigned or upstreamPatterns aborts the release (§29)
rules.upstreamSignatures: existing upstream signatures are checked but never replaced (§29)
